text:
maya: Quick sync — planning rollout for the adaptive traffic circuit-breaker feature. Main goals: protect p95 latency SLA, bound cost uplift from extra fallbacks/cooling, and give per-tenant opt-outs.

sam: Agree. Thinking of flag surface: one flag with params vs two flags (routing + circuit-breaker). My vote: two flags to minimize blast radius and allow independent rollouts.

kevin: Circuit-breaker triggers proposal:
- p95 latency > 300ms for 2m sliding window OR
- error rate > 1% for 2m
On trigger: switch traffic to fallback model-variant or `dedicated-slow-path` and alert.
Need to record event to telemetry: `cb_triggered` with reason + tenant + route.

anya: For ML quality: fallback should be validated on small shadow traffic first. Metrics to monitor: embedding cosine drift (median, 95th), downstream retrieval recall @k. Threshold: quality regression <1.0% vs baseline for rollforward.

olivia: Ops note: customers who've requested strict determinism (enterprise) need per-tenant override. We should expose `flag:adaptive_cb_policy` with `force_off` and `force_on` gateways for account ops.

ben: Sales input: a few top customers (ACME, NovaHealth) insisted on a 'no-fallback' SLA. We should offer contractual opt-out but require separate testing and capacity reservation. Flag needs typed owner.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan suggestion: canary -> ramp
```
canary: 5% for 1h
ramp: 20% for 6h
ramp2: 50% for 24h
full: 100% after green checks
auto-rollback if alerts fire > 3x in 10m
```
Add kill-switch: `feature_toggle:adaptive_cb_global_kill`.

sam: A/B testing: name cohorts `cb-control` and `cb-candidate`. Randomized by tenant hash with seed; track per-tenant conversion signals and latency. Run for min 72h or until N=~10k requests per cohort.

maya: Launch criteria (must all pass):
- p95 latency change <= +10% in production experiments
- cost per 1M tokens delta <= +10%
- quality regression (recall/precision) <= 1%
- no sustained error-rate increase > 0.5% across any region
- onboarding docs and ops runbook published

kevin: Add chaos-sim test in staging: simulate partial upstream (slow KV + overloaded GPUs) and validate circuit-breaker triggers and recovery. Also add per-region circuit thresholds (EU vs US have different baselines).

anya: Instrumentation: emit `cb_decision` event with fields: `tenant_id`, `route`, `decision`, `p95_ms`, `error_pct`, `model_variant`. Also capture sample of input+output hashes for offline QA (PII-scrubbed).

olivia: Docs and runbook owners: @maya (PM) drafts runbook, @kevin (SRE) adds operational playbook, @anya (ML) adds quality checklist. Target: first draft in 3 working days.

maya: Scope negotiation: MVP excludes per-tenant reserved capacity; we'll implement opt-out and per-tenant flags now, reserved capacity as follow-on if customer wants guaranteed 'no fallback'.

ben: Sounds reasonable. We'll surface the reserved-capacity wording in contracts and ask legal to add clause.

sam: Action items:
- implement dual-flag surface + config schema (me)
- telemetry events + histogram buckets (kevin)
- shadow validation harness for fallback (anya)
- docs + runbook draft (maya/olivia)
- customer gating UI for ops (product-UI)

maya: Thanks — will send a short PRD and post the rollout checklist here once done. :thumbsup:

kevin: +1, we should also schedule a 30m ops tabletop before the 20% ramp.

olivia: pinging legal & sales for customer opt-out process. @ben can you list customers we need to pre-notify?

ben: I'll DM the list and loop in AMs. 

maya: Closing — plan agreed, owners assigned. Reopen here for any blockers.
